text:
alex: heads-up: customers asking for clearer migration guarantees. proposal: a lightweight risk + opt-in flow that we can reuse across catalog upgrades. thoughts?
maria: yes please. they want predictable windows and a way to stay on older version for specific endpoints (pin exemptions). we need to capture that in Console UX.
ken: from a metric perspective, let's bake a single composite pass criteria: (1) perf p95 delta <= 15ms OR p95 percentile within tier; (2) semantic regression rate <1.5% on core suite; (3) token-cost delta <=8%. fail any -> no-default-swap. also compute a risk_score from these.
sarah: love the risk_score idea. add operational checks: quantized variants present, kv-cache sanity, sharded weights matched. if any infra check fails -> block opt-in for customers with strict isolation.
josh: ops workflow: implement "early cohort" toggle. flow: internal smoke -> invited cohort (customers who opt-in) -> monitored ramp -> default swap. default swap only if risk_score < threshold and no high-severity incidents in 7d.
priya: benchmarks split: microbench (64/256/1024 sequences, bursty traffic sim) + semantic (pinned prompt set + customer-provided critical prompts). require n>=200 for semantic per prompt type. store raw outputs for diffs.
luis: add a customer-contract artifact: for enterprise customers, we attach a migration contract that documents rollback clauses, SLA credits if swap causes regressions, and a "pin exemption" list by route. Legal + Sales will want a template.
maria: Console ask: add flags per-customer: "auto-upgrade: on/off", "early-access: yes/no", "exempt-routes: list". default remains on for self-serve but enterprise gets explicit UI. also add a note showing estimated cost delta.
ken: monitoring: wire three automatic alerts: quality_regression (trend up), latency_drift, billing_delta. thresholds should be configurable per-catalog-tier. send alerts to #eng-runtime + oncall.
sarah: rollback policy: reversible pin for 7 days after default swap. automated rollback triggers: >2x user-facing error rate, >3% semantic regressions on ongoing sampling, or p95 increase >50ms for more than 30 minutes. non-automated rollbacks go through a service review.
josh: canaries: implement two modes: "broad canary" (10% traffic to internal + invited customers) and "focused canary" (target routes with high risk, e.g., long-context). add canary-check cli: `rw-canary --new model-x --old model-y --suite full --mode focused`. hook this into deploy-bot to annotate deploys.
deploy-bot: rw-canary started for catalog/eta-next vs eta-stable (suite: full, mode: focused). results ETA: 20m.
alex: good. let's codify an "opt-in contract" in playbook: timeframe for early access (default 14 days), minimum sample sizes, monitoring windows, communication templates, and enterprise pin exemption flow. keep it lightweight so PMs can run it per-release.
priya: timeline ask: can we pilot this on eta-next next week? i'll prepare the semantic suite and a small customer invite list.
ken: i'll draft thresholds + dashboard panels by eod tomorrow.
maria: i'll work on Console toggles + copy. ping me for UX review.
sarah: i'll write the rollback runbook and mapping to routing layer.
josh: ops will add the canary toggle + automation to mark models as "invited only". we'll also add a migration state in the catalog API.
luis: i'll draft the enterprise migration contract template and share with Sales.
deploy-bot: rw-canary finished: pass=conditional, issues=long-context semantics. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/2141604321
priya: looking at logs now. failures are concentrated in prompts with >2048 tokens, hallucinations and tokenization oddities. sending examples privately.
ken: propose we add a focused regression test for long-context (2048/4096) and block default swap until fixed. allow enterprise opt-ins with a prominent risk banner.
alex: agreed. keep opt-in open but toggle default swap off for this release. action items: ken -> thresholds + dashboards (48h). priya -> semantic suite + customer invite list (48h). josh -> canary CLI + invited toggle (72h). maria -> Console flags + cost copy (72h). sarah -> rollback runbook (72h). luis -> enterprise contract draft (72h). i'll publish the playbook once we have triage results.
maria: noted, will follow up on PR. :thumbsup:
ken: starting thresholds doc now.
priya: kicking off long-context focused runs, will paste results here.
alex: thanks team — reconvene after triage.
